title: LinkedIn Job Scraper v2 — Keyword-Based Search

jobTitle.title: Job Title
jobTitle.description: The job title to search for (e.g. 'Software Engineer'). Embedded directly in the keywords query.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: List of skills to include in the search (e.g. [".NET", "Python"]). Appended to the keywords query.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location name (e.g. 'Seattle, Washington' or 'United States'). Auto-resolved to LinkedIn geoId.

datePosted.title: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted.

jobType.title: Job Type
jobType.description: Filter by employment type. Embedded in keywords AND post-filtered on our side for accuracy.

workType.title: Work Type
workType.description: Filter by work location type. Embedded in keywords.

experienceLevel.title: Experience Level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by seniority level. Embedded in keywords.

maxJobs.title: Max Jobs to Scrape
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of matching job listings to scrape. Scraper keeps paginating until this count is met.
